title: Grade 7 French — Wed, Jun 03
description: Le futur proche — Day 3 of 5: Future time expressions and the negative
subject: french

questions.question: What does 'demain' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Demain' = tomorrow. Common with the futur proche: 'Demain, je vais étudier.'

questions.question: What does 'ce soir' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Ce soir' = tonight / this evening. 'Ce soir, je vais regarder un film.'

questions.question: What does 'bientôt' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Bientôt' = soon. 'Le train va arriver bientôt.' = The train is going to arrive soon.

questions.question: How do you make the futur proche negative? 'I am NOT going to eat.'
questions.explanation: Put 'ne...pas' around ALLER (the conjugated verb): 'Je ne vais pas manger.' The infinitive stays at the end.

questions.question: Complete: 'Demain, nous ___ aller à la plage.' (we are going to go to the beach)
questions.explanation: 'Demain, nous allons aller à la plage.' nous allons + 'aller'.

questions.question: Make negative: 'Tu vas sortir.' (You are going to go out → You are NOT going to go out.)
questions.explanation: 'Tu ne vas pas sortir.' ne + vas + pas + infinitive 'sortir'.

questions.question: Translate: 'Tonight, I am going to read a book.'
options: Ce soir, je vais lire un livre.
Ce matin, je vais lire un livre.
Ce soir, je lis un livre.
Ce soir, je vais lis un livre.
questions.explanation: 'Ce soir, je vais lire un livre.' 'Ce soir' = tonight; je vais + 'lire'.

questions.question: Complete: 'Il ne ___ pas venir.' (He is not going to come.)
questions.explanation: 'Il ne va pas venir.' ne + va + pas + 'venir'.

questions.question: What does 'dans deux jours' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Dans deux jours' = in two days (a point in the future). 'Dans + time' = in/after that time.

questions.question: Translate: 'Next week, we are going to travel.'
options: La semaine prochaine, nous allons voyager.
La semaine dernière, nous allons voyager.
La semaine prochaine, nous allons voyageons.
questions.explanation: 'La semaine prochaine, nous allons voyager.' nous allons + 'voyager'.

questions.question: Make negative: 'Ils vont gagner.' (They are NOT going to win.)
questions.explanation: 'Ils ne vont pas gagner.' ne + vont + pas + 'gagner'.

questions.question: Which time expression fits the future?
options: il y a deux jours (two days ago)
questions.explanation: 'Demain' (tomorrow) points to the future. The others all point to the past.

questions.question: Translate: 'I am not going to be late tomorrow.'
options: Je ne vais pas être en retard demain.
Je vais être en retard demain.
Je ne vais être pas en retard demain.
Je ne suis pas en retard demain.
questions.explanation: 'Je ne vais pas être en retard demain.' ne + vais + pas + 'être'; 'demain' = tomorrow.
